title: Alchemy Tales v1.1.0 Update Notes
author: Ok-Construction6990
selftext:
1.Added timed treasure floors to Secret Realms for more rewarding treasure hunts.

https://i.redd.it/iw5u7vcgxfwh1.png

2.Rebalanced equipment, artifacts, and enchantments. Added re-enchanting and improved stat tooltips.

3.Added individual shield durability. Surviving shields are fully repaired after clearing a floor.

4.Improved defeat and retreat summaries. Items purchased in Secret Realm shops now go directly into storage.

5.Improved map zooming, scene visuals, and consecutive manual use.

6.Fixed large Spirit Stone values on leaderboards, right-click enchantment cancellation, and various UI issues.

Thank you for your support and feedback!
